mentions.name: Briefin
mentions.description: This platform turns any topic into a newsletter. It avoids embeddings and typical ranking systems, instead using AI agents to deliver precise results and content that is actually interesting to the reader. A companion tool turns Hacker News into a personalized daily digest with summaries of the discussions.
mentions.problem: Passive social media feeds serve click-driven content rather than precise, personally interesting results.
mentions.audience: Wants to replace passive social media feeds for readers who get served click-driven content instead of what's actually interesting to them.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://briefin.com/, which turns any topic into a newsletter.

evidence.value: I'm working on https://briefin.com/, which turns any topic into a newsletter.
